builder.objective: V2-05 repair — Fix the 4 remaining mustFix findings (F1-F4). The WIP repair baseline is preserved. F5 is fixed. All other V2-00..V2-04 criteria are complete and preserved.
builder.scope:
MustFix repairs required:

F1: Fix native share sheet on Android. expo-sharing shareAsync requires a file:// URI, not plain text. Either (a) write share text to a temp file via expo-file-system and pass file:// URI, or (b) use React Native Share.share() for text sharing, or (c) use react-native-view-shot + expo-file-system for image sharing. Add test asserting native API receives valid file URI.

F2: Integrate visual ShareCard into the share flow. Render <ShareCard/> in at least one screen (ScoreScreen or AddTaskScreen), capture as image, share via SystemShareGateway. The share flow must produce a visual ChoreScore card, not just plain text.

F3: Produce the reproducible visual evidence gallery (12+ screens from DESIGN_BRIEF) as audit artifacts: connexion, racine foyers, Ajouter Premium, Ajouter Free + archive, Score Premium, Score Free, To-do Premium, mini-form, To-do Free, upsell, Options, share card.

F4: Darken textMuted from #7A7A87 to >=4.5:1 on background (#FFF8F0), surface (#FFFFFF), and surfaceAlt (#FFF0E6). Also fix warning if used for text. Extend contrast test in Section 7 to cover every used text/surface pair including textMuted and warning.

Acceptance: all 4 findings resolved, 368+ tests green, typecheck clean, Android build OK, 3 tabs preserved, no social SDK, no data destruction.
